# Agorasim

> Agorasim runs guided countryside experiences in the Saloia region of Portugal — the countryside between Sintra, Mafra and Ericeira — most of them aboard restored classic cars. Small-group and private tours combine vineyards, gastronomy, villages, natural monuments and the Atlantic coast. A second route runs from Lisbon to the walled town of Óbidos and the medieval villages around it.

## Key facts
- Location: Saloia region (Sintra · Mafra · Ericeira), Portugal. The Óbidos route departs from Lisbon.
- Classic cars used: Citroën 2CV (1986), Renault 4L (1989), Fiat 600 (1970), Volkswagen T3 (1988). The Óbidos route is driven in a touring vehicle, not a classic car.
- Languages: Portuguese, English
- Departures: two a day, morning and afternoon. Rural Saloia leaves at 10:00 and 14:00; the Óbidos departure time is confirmed with the booking.
- Booking: online and instant at https://agorasim.pt/en/reservar — pick the tour, the date, the departure, the group and any add-ons, and pay by card. Confirmation is immediate; no waiting for a reply. Parties of more than 8 guests use the enquiry form on the same page, which is also the fallback for anything the calendar cannot sell. Enquiries by phone or email are always welcome.
- Cancellation: free up to 48 hours before the experience, with a full refund. In bad weather the team reschedules by email; in extreme conditions it refunds.
- Children: aged 4–12 pay a reduced rate; infants under 4 are free. Everyone counts towards the seats in the car.
- Contacts: Diogo +351 926 210 707 · Rita +351 919 272 077 · info@agorasim.pt
- Weddings and events: classic-car hire for weddings (transport of the couple, a photo session, floral decoration, personalised wooden boards) and tailor-made experiences for groups, companies and special occasions. Both are quoted individually, not booked through the calendar — request a quote at https://agorasim.pt/en/casamentos or https://agorasim.pt/en/eventos.

## Tours
- [Rural Saloia](https://agorasim.pt/en/experiencias/rural-saloia): the flagship classic-car tour, about 4h30, from Sintra and Mafra to Ericeira, taking in natural monuments, the National Palace of Mafra, vineyards, villages, regional sweets and the Atlantic coast. A local host drives; guests never drive the classic car. Meeting point: Av. Mário Firmino Miguel, Sintra (Portela de Sintra). Public departures from €62 per adult, €58 per adult from four adults, €35 per child. Private departures from €220 for up to three adults, rising by group size to €700 for twelve, €30 per child.
- [Óbidos & Medieval Villages](https://agorasim.pt/en/experiencias/obidos-medieval-villages): a guided food tour of about 5h from central Lisbon, through the walled town of Óbidos and lesser-known medieval villages, with a traditional food and wine break along the way. Not driven in the classic cars — those stay with the Saloia-region experiences. Meeting point: Alameda Cardeal Cerejeira, Lisboa. Public departures €100 per adult with a minimum of two adults, €40 per child. Private departures €360 for up to three adults, then €110 per adult, €40 per child.

## Add-ons
These join a **private** Rural Saloia tour; they are not sold on their own.
- [Tasco Galapito](https://agorasim.pt/en/experiencias/tasco-galapito): private family-style meal of traditional Saloia cuisine, about 2h. €60 per adult, €25 per child, minimum two guests. Dietary requirements are adapted on request.
- [Manzwine](https://agorasim.pt/en/experiencias/manzwine): wine tasting with historical context in the Mafra region, about 1h30. €35 per adult, minimum two adults. Closed on Mondays.
- [Ramilo Wines](https://agorasim.pt/en/experiencias/ramilo-wines): organic vineyard visit with tasting near the Atlantic, about 1h30. €45 per adult, minimum three adults.
